message: Consensus variants for comparison. Public picks use Signal 75 first with consensus as points overlay.

signal_first_consensus_overlay_v1.description: 14 June live rule: Signal 75 score first, exact consensus points as overlay, no hard tipster gate.

baseline_live_rule.description: Previous value-band rule; no consensus gate.

tipster_first_live_rule.description: Current live rule: no tipped horses passed Signal 75 value filters.

consensus_rank_v1.description: Soft rank boost: consensus sources nudge ranking but do not block picks.

consensus_prefer_tipped_v1.description: Prefer tipped horses first, then fill with normal value-band picks if needed.

consensus_strict_tipped_v1.description: Strict paper test: only horses with at least one consensus source.
